Read international CRS data into R

Source: R/read_international_crs.R
read_international_crs.Rd

This function connects to a specified DuckDB database table to retrieve CRS (Creditor Reporting System) activity level data of Official Development Finance (ODA/OOF) from official donors (DAC, non-DAC, multilaterals) and private philantropy, starting from 1960 to the recent year. It returns all the data in the database table as a tibble. The database file is expected to be located in a synchronized SharePoint directory on the user's local computer. Data source: https://stats.oecd.org/DownloadFiles.aspx?DatasetCode=CRS1

Usage

read_international_crs()

Value

A tibble containing international CRS data.

Examples

?read_oda()
